Math and AT.exp:
Remaining green ball = (8 – 1) = 7
Remaining blue ball = (4 – 1) = 3
and, white ball = 3
∴ probability of getting a blue ball = 3/(7 + 3 + 3) = 3/13

29) If the length of each of the sides of three square garden’s plot is increased by 50%, by what percent is the sum of the areas of the three plot’s increased?
Math and AT.exp:
Let,
Side of a square garden = 100
So, area = (100)2 = 10000
Sum of the area of 3 square garden = 3 × 10000 = 30000
After 50% increase side of a square becomes = (100 + 50% of 100) = 150
So, area = 1502 = 22500
Area of 3 square = 22500 × 3 = 67500
Area increases = (67500 - 30000) = 37500
So, percentage of increase = (37500×100)/30000 = 125%
